comment: A layer keeps the name the painter typed. A layer Ink is added and wrapped in a group, and the Layers docker is put where the shots see it (shot 1). The group's row, the top one, is opened by a double click, 'Sky v1.2: dusk' typed and Enter pressed (shot 2, the state's layers line). Ink's row, the second, is renamed the same way to '50% glaze, Ref: face' (shot 3). The document is saved and opened again, and the layers line and the shot read the two names and the group back (shot 4). Last, the picture photo.v2.jpg is placed, which makes a layer named photo.v2 (shot 5).
